observations: Photo 0 shows a pair of car headlamp assemblies (left and right) with clear lenses and chrome/reflector internals.
No readable brand/model or vehicle year markings are visible on the headlamps in the photo.
The seller’s text says “headlights is Very neat as new one,” but the photo alone cannot confirm condition beyond visible cleanliness.

claims.claim: The headlights is Very neat as new one
claims.evidence: Only visible cleanliness is suggested by photo 0; no close-ups of cracks, moisture ingress, lens yellowing, or working bulbs/LEDs.

risks.risk: Wrong fitment (vehicle model/year not confirmed), which can make the headlamps unusable even if they look neat.
risks.proof: Ask for a photo of the headlamp label/part number (sticker/engraving) and the vehicle it fits (year/make/model) shown clearly.
risks.if_unproven: Price as generic/unverified fitment risk (worst case: may not fit).

risks.risk: Not working (bulbs/LEDs, wiring, or internal reflectors may be faulty).
risks.proof: Ask for a short video clip showing both headlamps switched ON (low beam and high beam if applicable).
risks.if_unproven: Price as not working until proven.

risks.risk: Lens damage or moisture/condensation inside (can be hidden in a single photo).
risks.proof: Ask for close-up photos of the lens edges and inside reflections, plus a photo taken with the headlamp tilted to show any haze/condensation.
risks.if_unproven: Price as potentially damaged/with hidden defects.

risks.risk: Missing parts (covers, brackets, wiring harness connectors) not visible in the photo.
risks.proof: Ask for a photo of everything included laid out (brackets, bulbs, wiring connectors, screws/clips).

proof_requests: Send a clear photo of the headlamp part number/label on each unit (sticker/engraving).
Tell the exact vehicle fitment (make/model/year) and show it in a photo or screenshot.
Send a video showing both headlamps ON (low/high) to confirm they work.
Send close-up photos of lens condition (no cracks, no haze) and check for any moisture/condensation inside.
Show what is included (connectors, bulbs/LED modules, brackets/clips) with a laid-out photo.
response.reason: The photo shows a pair of headlamp assemblies, but the exact vehicle fitment/part number and working condition cannot be confirmed remotely, so a safe worst-case price cannot be chosen confidently from the comparables.
